issue_request: FHIR-38903 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO R6 change request to reduce confusion from repeated deviceIdentifier naming under DeviceDefinition.regulatoryIdentifier by renaming deviceIdentifier to identifier, renaming deviceIdentifierSystem to identifierSystem, and updating associated definitions plus jurisdiction short/definition text.
initial_application: PR #3842 applied the change before this reconciliation. Commit 11436a5fa623b1beb38a21b8562435125efc4117 updated source/devicedefinition/structuredefinition-DeviceDefinition.xml with the regulatoryIdentifier path renames and wording changes, and merge commit f8a725b7b0967fe6dd9f4f3cbc0d73a205ef9086 brought that work into the main history.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists devicedefinition as a current resource, so the inspected StructureDefinition XML is in build scope. R5 history contains regulatoryIdentifier.deviceIdentifier but no regulatoryIdentifier.deviceIdentifierSystem, which makes the current R5-to-R6 fhir.ini metadata correct: deviceIdentifier maps to identifier, while identifierSystem is marked new. OO minutes show the issue was deferred in 2023 and later accepted in a 2025 block vote; Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative DeviceDefinition source already reflects the final Jira resolution, and no missing fhir.ini rename or conflicting community evidence was found.
